baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated يُبَايِعُونَكَ / يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ construction and the paired hands turn one visible act toward the messenger into an act whose ultimate counterparty is God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The allegiance branch supplies the legal-social act, the sale branch keeps reciprocal exchange active, and the hand-to-hand branch gives the transaction a bodily interface. The restrictive إِنَّمَا does the reader-visible transposition: the human addressee receives the act, while God owns its binding force.

activation_trace.role: The obedience-pledge branch makes the repeated act a binding allegiance transaction and supplies the model's public contract.
The sale-and-purchase branch keeps reciprocal exchange latent inside the allegiance formula and makes later reward a settlement rather than an unrelated gift.
The hand-to-hand delivery branch gives the mediated transaction a concrete transfer interface between the visible and ultimate counterparties.

changed_reading.before: The people swear personal loyalty to the messenger and will later be rewarded for keeping it.
changed_reading.after: The visible hand-pledge is a mediated allegiance exchange: it reaches the messenger bodily but binds as a transaction with God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ places one divine hand over the participants' plural hands.
baseline_models.mechanism: The authority-hand and surrender-hand branches form a vertical jurisdiction: the lower hands enact and submit, while the upper hand supplies the commanding sovereignty under which the pledge has force. The dominance branch of ف و ق makes this a hierarchy of agency, not only a spatial tableau.

activation_trace.role: The sovereign-hand branch supplies effective authority to the singular hand above the participants' hands.
The ascendancy branch converts vertical فوق into jurisdiction and governing superiority.
The surrendered-hand branch makes the lower hands signs of submission, guarantee, and pledged liability.

changed_reading.before: God is present as a superior witness to a human ceremony.
changed_reading.after: The ceremony is nested inside divine jurisdiction: the participants' hands act only within the authority of the hand above them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same singular-over-plural hand construction can depict an enabling hand held over a joined body, not only a hand dominating it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of ي د ي preserves a strongly aided power branch alongside the hand's support and benefaction branches. Read together with simple spatial فوق, the upper hand can underwrite, protect, or empower the many lower hands. This coexists with the authority model because support and sovereignty need not exclude one another.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped root's reinforced-power branch activates divine enablement within the hand image.
The supporting-hand branch makes the upper hand a source of aid and collective reinforcement.
The benefaction-hand branch lets superiority include prior grace that enables the pledge and its fulfillment.
The literal vertical branch preserves the covering over-hand arrangement without deciding that its sole function is coercion.

changed_reading.before: The hand above means only that divine power outranks human power.
changed_reading.after: The hand above may simultaneously authorize and strengthen the pledged hands, making fidelity enabled from above rather than merely demanded from above.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ repeats the breach root and directs its effect back onto the breacher's own self.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material image of undoing a cord after it was made firm renders covenant breach as deconstruction. The covenant branch identifies what is undone, while نفس as the thing's own identity makes the reflexive consequence more than external punishment: the breacher loosens the coherence by which that self had become bound.

activation_trace.role: The unravelling-after-twisting branch supplies the material mechanism of breach as self-deconstruction.
The confirmed-covenant breach branch fixes the material unravelling to the pledge rather than to a free-standing textile image.
The safeguarded compact branch identifies the structure whose integrity has been entrusted to the pledger.
The self-as-the-thing-itself branch localizes the unravelled consequence in the agent's own identity and integrity.

changed_reading.before: Breaking the pledge violates an obligation and incurs a penalty.
changed_reading.after: Breaking the pledge unweaves the breacher's own constituted integrity; the divine side of the bond is not what the breach diminishes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ ... فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا moves from covenant maintenance through full performance to a future payment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence is a contract lifecycle rather than a single sincere instant. عهد requires repeated custody, وفى carries the obligation to undiminished completion, and إيتاء plus أجر settles the completed performance as a return on work. عظيم scales the settlement without changing that functional chain.

activation_trace.role: The repeated-care branch makes covenant fidelity an obligation maintained state after state.
The complete-without-deficiency branch supplies the performance threshold that closes the obligation.
The giving branch makes the promised consequence a directed transfer to the fulfiller.
The work-compensation branch frames the transfer as earned settlement while retaining the broader sense of recompense.
The magnitude-and-strength branch marks the settlement as exceeding an ordinary contractual return.

changed_reading.before: A sincere pledge earns a large reward.
changed_reading.after: The pledge initiates durable custody of a compact; complete performance reaches a settlement whose magnitude exceeds the ordinary exchange latent in the pledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَٰهَدَ, يُؤْتِيهِ, and أَجْرًا can form a secondary material chain of recurrent tending, produced yield, and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of عهد pictures rain revisiting already wetted ground, while an إتيان branch names the emergence of crop or fruit yield. The focus verse can therefore carry a latent cultivation analogy: fidelity repeatedly tends what the pledge began until it produces a return. This does not replace the covenant and payment senses; it gives them a temporal-material image.

activation_trace.role: The revisiting-rain branch supplies recurrent tending of ground already made receptive as an analogy for maintained covenant.
The emerging-growth and fruit-yield branch turns the future giving into the production stage of the cultivation analogy.
The return-on-work branch closes the analogy by making cultivated yield consequential rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Covenant keeping is static compliance until reward arrives.
changed_reading.after: Covenant keeping can be pictured as recurrent cultivation whose maintained relation eventually brings forth its own promised yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening root at 48:1 contributes both a beginning that opens what follows and a judicial separation that releases closure. Set before the focus pledge, it lets the compact function as a threshold inside an already opened process: allegiance enters a new field of action and adjudication rather than merely commemorating a finished victory.

activation_trace.role: The allegiance-transaction branch supplies the binding threshold crossed by the pledgers.
The safeguarded-compact branch gives the opened process a durable juridical form.
The beginning-that-opens-what-follows branch frames the pledge as an entry point with consequences still unfolding.
The judgment-that-releases-closure branch adds adjudication to the opening and anticipates the focus verse's two consequence paths.

structural_cues: 48:1 doubles the opening root in verb and cognate noun before the focus verse.
48:10 itself doubles both pledge and breach, then divides breach and fulfillment into opposed outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening at the pericope's start and a bifurcating covenant in the focus; I infer that the first can frame the second as a threshold and adjudicative mechanism. A live alternative is that 48:1's opening names only victory and does not specify the pledge's function.

changed_reading.before: The pledge responds to an opening or victory already granted.
changed_reading.after: The pledge may itself be a threshold into what the opening releases, with fidelity and breach becoming the two adjudicated paths through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding assignment of the addressee as sent messenger and present, knowledgeable witness revises the mediated-exchange baseline. His hand can be the public point at which allegiance is witnessed and transmitted, while إِنَّمَا locates the transaction's ultimate binding counterpart in God.

activation_trace.role: The allegiance branch supplies the binding act received through the second-person addressee.
The messenger-and-message branch supplies an authorized transmitting office rather than an independent terminal counterparty.
The present-observation branch makes the public pledge an event received under witness.
The testimony-from-knowledge branch gives the messenger's presence an evidentiary function in the transaction.

structural_cues: 48:8 names the second-person addressee through commissioned roles before 48:10 addresses him as pledge recipient.
48:10 repeats the same pledge verb on both sides of restrictive إِنَّمَا while changing only the object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger and witness roles plus the focus's object-switch; I infer an authorized witness-interface between visible act and ultimate bond. The live alternative is that witness is only one role among several and should not define the pledge mechanism by itself.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is the human counterparty whose receipt is simply equated with God's receipt.
changed_reading.after: The messenger can be read as the commissioned witness-interface through whom the visible act becomes evidentially and juridically a pledge to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse exposes speech on tongues that is absent from hearts, then closes with God's knowledge of action. That three-channel mismatch sharpens the focus's reflexive breach: a hand can perform allegiance while tongue, heart, and subsequent deed fail to cohere, so نكث becomes fragmentation of the acting self.

activation_trace.role: The branch that attributes deeds to hands makes the pledge gesture answerable as the pledger's own action.
The unravelling branch models loss of coherence among the self's outward and inward channels.
The self-as-own-identity branch locates that channel split in the agent rather than in the divine compact.
The bodily tongue branch supplies the explicit outward speech channel that can diverge from inward commitment.
The heart branch supplies the inward channel whose absence from speech exposes divided allegiance.
The intentional-action branch adds the subsequent deed channel by which pledged integrity is tested.

structural_cues: 48:11 follows the focus immediately and explicitly negates correspondence between tongue and heart.
48:10's hand, self, and repeated breach already form an outward-act-to-inward-consequence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hand-action in the focus and tongue/heart/action channels in 48:11; I infer that covenant integrity requires their coherence and that breach is their unravelling. A live alternative is that 48:11 diagnoses only the stay-behind speakers, without defining every possible breach in 48:10.

changed_reading.before: Breach is a later decision to cancel an earlier hand pledge.
changed_reading.after: Breach can begin as internal incoherence: hand, tongue, heart, and deed cease to constitute one pledged self, so the damage returns upon that self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wish to substitute God's speech at 48:15 and the denial of substitution in God's established path at 48:23 distinguish two levels of change. A person can undo or replace their own enacted commitment, but cannot rewrite the divine word or governing pattern; the attempted alteration therefore recoils as self-loss, exactly as عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ states.

activation_trace.role: The undoing-after-firming branch supplies the local change a breacher can actually perform.
The self-as-own-identity branch identifies what the ineffective attack on the larger order successfully alters.
The safeguarded compact branch makes covenant a preserved order against which private substitution is measured.
The image-changing branch supplies the attempted alteration of the given speech.
The intelligible-word branch identifies a determinate utterance that the would-be followers seek to change.
The running-path branch supplies the durable divine pattern that remains in force across instances.
The replacement branch contributes the explicit impossibility of installing another thing in the divine pattern's place.

structural_cues: 48:15 presents an intention to change God's speech, while 48:23 closes a repeated divine pattern with no substitution.
48:10 restricts the consequence of undoing with a second إِنَّمَا and the reflexive عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted word-change, invariant pattern, and reflexive breach; I infer that breach changes the participant's relation and constitution rather than the divine rule. A live alternative is that the two substitution passages concern separate historical directives and only analogically illuminate the focus compact.

changed_reading.before: A breacher cancels the covenant relation for both sides.
changed_reading.after: A breacher can unmake their own participation but cannot substitute a new divine word or pattern; the only successfully altered object is the breacher's own standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:18 the same pledge is located under a tree, followed by knowledge of what is in hearts, delivery of stillness, and a returned recompense in the form of a near opening. This sequence revises the hand ceremony into a coupled exterior-interior process: the bodily pledge exposes a heart-state, and divine response settles that interior before returning an outward opening.

activation_trace.role: The anatomical-hand branch anchors the model in the focus's public bodily gesture.
The repeated allegiance branch identifies 48:18 as a direct contextual realization of the focus transaction.
The disclosure-to-knower branch opens the inward state that accompanies the visible pledge.
The heart branch supplies the interior site read by the divine counterparty.
The caused-delivery branch gives the response a downward movement from divine knowledge into the pledgers.
The cessation-of-motion branch makes tranquility an actual settling of interior agitation.
The recompense-returning-to-the-worker branch links the settled heart to an answering return.
The opening-that-begins-what-follows branch renders the near recompense as access to a new outward phase.

structural_cues: 48:18 repeats the focus pledge verb and then sequences knowing, descending, settling, recompensing, and opening.
The focus moves from plural hands to the singular self, leaving room for 48:18 to disclose the heart between public act and consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct pledge recurrence followed by heart-knowledge, descent, stillness, recompense, and opening; I infer a causal response chain from sincere interior state to settled capacity and outward consequence. A live alternative is that these are coordinated favors without a strict causal order.

changed_reading.before: The hand pledge is complete as a public legal act, with reward deferred until later fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: The hand pledge is an exterior interface to an interior settlement: the heart is known and steadied, and that steadiness begins to return as opened capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated scenes of hands being restrained at 48:20 and 48:24 make divine superordination operational as limitation of reciprocal force. The following avoidance of trampling unknown believers and admission into mercy gives that restraint a protective object. The hand above can therefore govern by stopping hands, not only by making one side's hands prevail.

activation_trace.role: The sovereign-hand branch supplies the superordinate agency whose mode of rule is revised by the context.
The ascendancy branch anchors the reading in effective control rather than decorative verticality.
The restraint-and-prevention branch supplies the first explicit operation performed upon human hands.
The anatomical-hand branch makes the restrained object the same bodily agency displayed in the focus pledge.
The repeated prevention branch extends restraint symmetrically across both opposed parties.
The two hand occurrences provide the reciprocal human force that is held within a higher limit.
The crushing-pressure branch names the collateral injury that unrestrained advance could inflict.
The mercy-and-tenderness branch supplies the protective end served by restraining superior power.

structural_cues: 48:20 restrains people's hands; 48:24 restrains each side's hands from the other; 48:25 states an unseen collateral-risk condition.
The focus's singular hand above plural hands provides a compact spatial model for control over distributed human agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hand-restraint and a following risk of inadvertent crushing; I infer that superior control is exercised to bound violence and protect hidden members of the community. A live alternative is that the restraint is purely tactical victory-management, with mercy only a separate consequence.

changed_reading.before: The hand above chiefly guarantees that the pledged side has superior force.
changed_reading.after: The hand above can signify governance that limits every human hand, including allied hands, so that victory does not become uncontrolled injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:26 heated group pride is countered by descended stillness and an adhered word of protection. This relocates covenant fidelity from raw solidarity of hands to durable attachment to a regulating utterance under affective pressure. The fulfilled عهد is thus enacted when composure keeps the pledged community fastened to a protective norm.

activation_trace.role: The repeated-care branch supplies durable covenant maintenance beyond the original hand event.
The complete-performance branch makes steadfast attachment under pressure a mode of fulfilling the compact.
The heated-pride and anger branch supplies the affective force that threatens pledged coherence.
The loss-of-motion branch supplies composure as the counterforce to heated impulsion.
The lasting-attachment branch makes the regulating word something the believers remain fastened to.
The intelligible-utterance branch gives covenant maintenance a verbal norm rather than a merely affective group bond.
The harm-deflecting protection branch supplies the adhered word's function under provocation.

structural_cues: 48:26 opposes the heated impulse placed in one set of hearts to tranquility descended on the messenger and believers.
The same verse then uses causative attachment with a singular word, giving stillness a durable verbal form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provocation, settling, attachment, word, and protection; I infer that the attached protective word channels tranquility into covenant-keeping conduct. A live alternative is that the word names a general confessional formula rather than the operational norm of the focus pledge.

changed_reading.before: Fulfilling the pledge primarily means preserving allegiance to the group represented by joined hands.
changed_reading.after: Fulfilling the pledge includes remaining fastened to a protective word when group heat would otherwise drive the pledged hands beyond their limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing portrait moves from repeated bodily prostration to a distinguishing mark on faces that is a remaining trace of that act. This activates a body-wide account of the focus pledge: hands do not merely symbolize an inward choice once; repeated embodied fidelity leaves an identifying residue on the self.

activation_trace.role: The attribution-of-action-to-hands branch makes the pledge a deed whose bodily medium belongs to the acting self.
The self-as-own-identity branch gives bodily trace relevance to the focus's reflexive consequence.
The prostrating-members and their trace branch supplies repeated embodied action that can leave a residue.
The visible identifying-mark branch turns repeated bodily fidelity into a readable sign.
The face-as-the-self branch makes the sign disclose identity rather than remain a superficial mark.
The enduring-trace branch supplies persistence after the bodily act has ended.

structural_cues: 48:29 links a repeated posture, faces, and a remaining trace in one compact description.
48:10 likewise links a bodily member to the participant's own self and future standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hand-act in the focus and an act-to-mark-to-face chain in 48:29; I infer that sustained embodied fidelity can inscribe identity. A live alternative is that the prostration trace is a distinct devotional sign and does not generalize to the pledge gesture.

changed_reading.before: The hand pledge is a momentary sign that reports an already formed inward allegiance.
changed_reading.after: The embodied pledge can participate in forming and marking the self: repeated fidelity leaves a trace by which allegiance becomes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final crop sequence gives the focus's latent cultivation reading an explicit collective mechanism: an origin sends out shoots, the shoots reinforce it, the whole thickens, and it becomes upright. The plural pledged hands can now be read as interdependent growth units whose fidelity strengthens the body that also supports them; divine aid above is enabling power within that maturation.

activation_trace.role: The rain-that-revisits-wetted-ground branch supplies recurrent covenant tending before the crop context makes it explicit.
The growth-and-fruit-yield branch makes promised giving the emergence of a cultivated result.
The reinforced-power mapping connects the hand above to the strengthening movement of the crop.
The supporting-hand branch lets the many pledged hands function as mutually reinforcing members.
The crop-growth branch supplies the explicit organic domain for covenant maturation.
The emergence-to-the-outside branch makes latent allegiance appear as new collective growth.
The shoot-around-the-origin branch supplies differentiated members that remain organically related to their source.
The plant's mutual strengthening branch supplies the causal arrow from added members to a stronger whole.
The thickening-after-thinness branch gives covenant endurance a cumulative material result.
The integrity-and-completion branch makes upright maturity the collective analogue of full وفاء.

structural_cues: 48:29 presents an ordered growth chain: emergence, shoot, reinforcement, thickening, and upright completion.
48:10 moves from many hands under one hand to individual breach or fulfillment, allowing member-level choices to affect collective form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective crop whose shoots strengthen its origin and focus branches of support, tending, and yield; I map pledgers to interdependent shoots and fidelity to mutual reinforcement. A live alternative is that the crop describes communal expansion generally, not the mechanics of the pledge in particular.

changed_reading.before: The covenant binds separate individuals vertically to a superior authority and pays each fulfiller separately.
changed_reading.after: The covenant can also grow horizontally: each maintained pledge becomes a supporting shoot, and the resulting collective strength is part of the promised yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أجر normally activates compensation here, while its broken-bone branch is materially remote. It remains anchored through the focus's explicit unravelling of a compact upon the self and the same-root reward noun; downstream prose should present repair as a secondary material analogy for recompense, not as a replacement lexical translation of أَجْرًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes self-directed unravelling with a promised أجر, allowing the reward's repair branch to answer the breach's damage branch.

activation_trace.role: The unravelling-after-firming branch supplies a material loss of structural integrity.
The self-as-own-identity branch locates the structural damage in the person.
The complete-without-defect branch supplies the contrasting condition of restored or preserved integrity.
The setting of a broken bone supplies repair as an exploratory image within promised recompense.

changed_reading.before: The great reward is only external payment added after correct performance.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch field, recompense may include re-alignment or repair of the integrity that breach would have unravelled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it crosses remote milk-return and milk-flow branches of فوق and رسل, then uses the morning/evening endpoints as cadence. It remains anchored in the focus's doubled pledge verb and عهد as repeated care; downstream prose should call it a pulsed-renewal analogy, never claim that فَوْقَ or أَرْسَلْنَاكَ lexically means milking in these verses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pledge verb is repeated, عهد can require care state after state, and the unusual ف و ق inventory contains return between milkings and intake by intervals.

activation_trace.role: The return of milk between milkings supplies replenishment after an apparent depletion.
The taking-in-doses branch supplies an intermittent rather than once-only rhythm.
The care-renewed-state-after-state branch anchors cadence in covenant maintenance.
The successive milk-flow branch echoes replenishing transmission from the context.
The beginning-of-day branch supplies one endpoint of a repeated daily cadence.
The evening-time branch closes the daily interval and makes recurrence visible.

changed_reading.before: Allegiance is completed in one ceremony and then merely remembered.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material rhythm, allegiance may need recurrent replenishment: the initial hand event is renewed in maintained intervals of practice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately cross-domain activation: سُوق in 48:29 denotes stalks in its immediate crop construction, yet the same root inventory also contains a marketplace branch that resonates with the focus's buying and wage field. It remains valid as a branch-mediated analogy anchored in ب ي ع, produced yield, and أجر; downstream prose must preserve the stalk sense and qualify the market link as latent wordplay rather than lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names allegiance through the sale root and closes with work-compensation, while 48:29 brings crop yield to upright سوق whose branch inventory also opens onto a market.

activation_trace.role: The buying-and-selling branch supplies the focus's latent exchange domain.
The crop-and-fruit yield branch carries maintained allegiance toward produced value.
The compensation-for-work branch supplies settlement at the end of the exchange-and-cultivation chain.
The cultivation-and-growth branch supplies the explicit production domain.
The supporting-stalk branch preserves the immediate botanical mechanism on which the crop stands.
The marketplace branch supplies the surprising latent bridge from mature crop to the focus's exchange and settlement field.

changed_reading.before: The pledge's exchange metaphor and the final crop image are independent figures.
changed_reading.after: A contained branch resonance links them into one production economy: pledged exchange is cultivated, stands mature, and returns as recompense.

strongest_changes: The hand above became a coexistence of authority, enablement, and restraint rather than a single image of dominance.
The direct pledge recurrence at 48:18 joined the public hand act to known hearts, descended stillness, returned recompense, and an opening.
Tongue-heart-action mismatch and the invariant divine word sharpened breach into self-fragmentation that cannot rewrite the larger compact.
The closing bodily trace and crop sequence activated identity-inscription and mutually reinforcing collective-growth readings.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the focus by moving the hand across domains without severing its anchor: legal exchange, sovereign jurisdiction, enabling support, restraint of violence, bodily inscription, and organic mutual reinforcement remained live together. The split ي د ي mapping and the crop/stalk/market branch crossing produced especially strong latent activation without requiring a single final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: Authority, support, benefaction, and restraint all fit the upper-hand mechanism; the packet strengthens each but does not force one to exhaust the others.
The messenger-as-witness-interface reading follows the role sequence and object-switch, but witness may supplement rather than define his place in the pledge.
Repair, pulsed replenishment, and crop-to-market settlement are deliberately branch-distant analogies and should never be rendered as direct lexical substitutions.
